entries.title: New skill
entries.detail: Ask for a skill that teaches a new way of working.

entries.title: skill-creator
entries.detail: Create or revise a reusable agent skill from a user's workflow, domain knowledge, or tool instructions.

entries.title: barcodes
entries.detail: Read and generate barcodes and QR codes. Use when an image may hold a code to decode, or the user wants one made.

entries.title: color
entries.detail: Choose, generate, and check colors. Use for palettes, shade scales, light and dark themes, chart colors, and contrast.

entries.title: create-page
entries.detail: Use when an answer is longer than a few paragraphs, better seen than read, or will be shared: a plan, comparison, or small tool.

entries.title: document-to-markdown
entries.detail: Convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and data files to Markdown for reading, search, or summarizing.

entries.title: docx
entries.detail: Read, create, and edit Word documents (.docx), including filling templates.

entries.title: ffmpeg
entries.detail: Convert, trim, compress, and edit local video and audio with FFmpeg, including GIFs, subtitles, and thumbnails.

entries.title: local-ml
entries.detail: Run local AI models with no API key. Use to remove image backgrounds, detect or describe objects, transcribe audio.

entries.title: markdown
entries.detail: Convert HTML pages and fragments to Markdown.

entries.title: media-download
entries.detail: Download video, audio, captions, and metadata from web links with yt-dlp. Use when a task needs media from a URL.

entries.title: pdf
entries.detail: Read, create, and edit PDF files (.pdf): design new documents in HTML printed by the browser, extract text and tables.

entries.title: powerpoint
entries.detail: Read, create, and edit PowerPoint presentations (.pptx), including decks built from templates.

entries.title: sharp-images
entries.detail: Resize, crop, convert, compress, and edit raster images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, and more) with Sharp.

entries.title: spreadsheet
entries.detail: Read, create, edit, and analyze spreadsheets and data files: Excel (.xlsx), Numbers, CSV, TSV, and Parquet.

entries.title: wireframe
entries.detail: Use when asked to wireframe, mock up or sketch a product screen or UI flow, or when an interface is being argued about.

entries.title: zip
entries.detail: Create, extract, and list zip archives (.zip).
